title: Jesus Is Born
summary: Jesus Is Born follows a real Bible moment about Jesus. Jesus came humbly as the Savior God promised. When important things look small, Jesus' birth reminds kids that God's rescue can arrive without spotlight or noise.

read_it.prompt: Read Luke 2:1-20 slowly and listen for the choice, promise, warning, or rescue in the story.

tell_it: Jesus was born in Bethlehem, and shepherds heard the good news from angels. They went to see Him and praised God. Kids can retell it by naming what happened, who responded, and what God showed.
understand_it: Jesus came humbly as the Savior God promised. Jesus Is Born also keeps the focus on who Jesus is and how people respond to Him.
age_5_7_explanation: Jesus was born humbly, just as God had promised.
age_8_11_explanation: Jesus came humbly as the Savior God promised. The lesson helps older kids compare the story's wise path with the easier path people may have wanted.
teen_explanation: When important things look small, Jesus' birth reminds kids that God's rescue can arrive without spotlight or noise. Jesus came humbly as the Savior God promised. The story leaves room to talk about courage, humility, repentance, or hope without pretending the hard part is small.
key_truths: Jesus came humbly as the Savior God promised.
Jesus Is Born shows Jesus through a real Bible moment, not a slogan.
When important things look small, Jesus' birth reminds kids that God's rescue can arrive without spotlight or noise.
life_application: When important things look small, Jesus' birth reminds kids that God's rescue can arrive without spotlight or noise.

activity.title: Nativity Promise Scene
activity.instructions: Build a simple manger scene and label the quiet ways God kept His promise.

prayer_prompt: Jesus, help me remember the truth in Jesus Is Born and live it with people around me.
